image_prompts.prompt: The character-consistent Triceratops from the config library at the victory ceremony, showing extreme physical exhaustion after winning. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Dusty ochre skin, thick leathery texture; massive head frill is a SOLID UNIFORM DEEP OCHRE. Symmetrical burnt orange tiger-stripe patterns on flanks. Three polished off-white horns. ACTION: He is positioned behind the three-tier wooden victory podium. His front legs are splayed slightly wide and trembling, resting heavily on the podium for support. His massive head is lowered, with his chin almost resting on the '1st Place' tier. He is breathing heavily, with visible steam or 'puff' clouds coming from his nostrils. A red 'Winner' ribbon is tangled comically around his nose horn. FACIAL EXPRESSION: Droopy, tired eyes and a slightly open beak with a lolling tongue, showing 'happy exhaustion'. SETTING: The finish line ceremony area; LANCE_HELL_CREEK environment with lush ferns. Background shows blurred, cheering dinosaur spectators. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3'. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC' with sweat-like sheen on his leathery skin. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' front-view.
